scope: descriptive, non-optimized feature specification; not a trading rule
level_universe: fixed price increments around those levels

event_definition.candidate_absorption: at a level, aggressive executed volume persists while displayed passive liquidity repeatedly restores; MBO sequence evidence is preferred
event_definition.mbp10_constraint: aggregate depth refills may be described but cannot prove a true iceberg

features.aggressive_volume_imbalance: signed executed volume in a fixed, predeclared event window; retain unknown/ambiguous side rather than force a label
features.displayed_replenishment: adds or restored displayed quantity following executions at the same price, separately tracking cancel/replace ambiguity
features.order_lifecycle: MBO order_id add/modify/cancel/execute counts and matched sequences where documented semantics permit
features.price_response: signed movement away from/toward level after a fixed observation window
features.queue_uncertainty: explicit missing/ambiguous flag; no queue-position claim

regime_normalization.method: per UTC date and RTH only, normalize each raw feature by a robust median and MAD computed over all eligible event windows for that date
regime_normalization.zero_mad: mark feature unavailable; do not substitute an optimized fallback

data_quality: do not infer unreported hidden quantity
